groups.root_cause: When exclusions remove every chat candidate, the chat failure path drops the origin-exclusion reason and reports a generic unavailability error.
Queued calls are dispatched without rechecking whether the selected model's current origin is excluded, so a catalog change made while the call waits is ignored.
Panel verifier selection does not filter out excluded verifiers before picking a target, so it can choose an excluded entry over an eligible independent model.
Eval resume does not check stored escalation chains against origin exclusions up front, so a run can spend its first round before failing on a prohibited model.
The private-output exhaustion error repeats the same origin-exclusion reason for every excluded model instead of deduplicating it.
A paragraph in docs/EVALS.md has an awkward manual line break.
Startup validation does not reject review roster finder pins that point to models with excluded origins.
